summary: Complete free-index extraction and nearest-operator indexing for the supported earlier LF; constructive support theorem and compiler truth checks.
implementation_scope: Authorized integration step implemented for selected construal trees and typed commands. Not a raw-English parser, full movement generator, total semantic decision procedure or completed pragmatic theory.

sources.citation: Heim, I. (1982). The Semantics of Definite and Indefinite Noun Phrases. Consulted Schoubye–Glick 2011 retypesetting, pp.90–100,105–111,118–120,234,247–254.
sources.available: Relevant primary-source passages read; single-assistant comparison, independent source review pending.

definitions_mapped.source: Free indices of the earlier indexed LF, with all explicit operator selections subtracted.
pp.90–100 nuclear/text closure and nearest-operator indexing on an already NP-prefixed, scope-resolved fragment; no movement generator.
pp.109–111 context-reference schema now supplied with computed rather than caller-provided free indices.
Constructive infrastructure establishing that syntactically free coordinates suffice for semantic dependence.

evidence: See campaigns/heim_1982_integration_results.md and every-theorem mechanical records. Existing source definitions are reused through explicit adapters; added integration machinery is identified above.
simplifications: pp.90–100 nuclear/text closure and nearest-operator indexing on an already NP-prefixed, scope-resolved fragment; no movement generator.
omissions: Raw-English analysis, general movement derivations and a complete generic/specific-indefinite theory are outside this step.
No chosen recency/prominence threshold, proxy-resolution algorithm, local/global accommodation preference or complete modal presupposition projection theory.
No whole-system equivalence between earlier indexed semantics and final FCS, and no total executable decision procedure for arbitrary interpretations.
additions: Constructive infrastructure establishing that syntactically free coordinates suffice for semantic dependence.

determination_rationale: Integration and source-linked conditional results are checked; this does not settle whole-source coverage, the earlier source wording clarification or open pragmatic policy choices.

artifact_classes.description: Explicit syntax traversal, assignment splicing, tagged trace storage and conservative adapters; added engineering is not evidence of necessary theoretical change.
